NTM auto-admission was darked in the Dhan→Groww cutover — `dashboard/instrument_loader.py` returned a fixed `_NTM_SKIPPED_NOTE` `{"admitted": False, …}`. This re-enables it by **MIRRORING the retired DEC-NIFTY-TOTAL-MARKET-LOAD-001 SEMANTICS against the Groww `InstrumentIndex`**, not the retired vendor calls. **What changed (ONE production file — `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py`):** `load_instrument_master` now (1) fetches NTM's constituent CSV best-effort from niftyindices (the already-vendor-agnostic `nse_constituents.fetch_constituent_csv` + `ntm_cache` last-good disk fallback), (2) matches each constituent to its Groww **NSE cash-equity** row via the COMMON vendor-neutral `universe_constituents.resolve_constituents` (ISIN-primary, ticker/`trading_symbol` fallback, O(1) per lookup), (3) admits the **NON-F&O** matches as REFERENCE_ONLY — threaded through `is_universe_underlying(…, reference_security_ids)` into the lean set + tagged via a custom `upsert_many(reference_only_of=…)` predicate (a module-level `_reference_only_of` factory) that ALSO preserves the India-VIX index-level flag — and (4) EXCLUDES any matched constituent that is ALSO F&O-eligible from the reference set so it keeps its real option chain (DEC-OPTIONS-PULL-GUARD-001). The universe reaching ~750 is **automatic via the store round-trip**: a persisted REFERENCE_ONLY EQ joins `store.fno_eligible_underlyings()` (the "every persisted NSE EQ" arm), so `universe_summary` counts it as a stock. **No new production code outside `instrument_loader.py`** — `is_universe_underlying`'s `reference_security_ids` arm, `is_reference_only`, `is_option_pullable`, the `reference_only` column, and `resolve_constituents` were all already vendor-neutral and survived the scrub (#693). **HARD SCOPE GUARD (CLAUDE.md §3):** the BRUTE-FORCE engine is UNCHANGED (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/SENSEX, locked by DEC-ENGINE-ISOLATION-INVARIANT-001) — NTM constituents are lake/REFERENCE_ONLY only, NEVER in the 52-vocab. **Fail-soft (Golden Rule #1/#10):** a niftyindices miss WITH a cache falls back to last-good (~750 preserved); a miss with NO cache degrades HONESTLY to the F&O-eligible base set with a `reason` note (never a 500, never invented constituents); an index-only/empty master skips the fetch entirely (no network). **Scenarios covered (offline, fakes injected — happy/edge/empty/failure/concurrent):** happy admit (non-F&O constituent → reference stock, counted in `stock_count`); F&O constituent stays tradable (matched, `reference=0`, option-pullable); India VIX + constituent both reference-only (custom predicate keeps the VIX tag — regression guard for the predicate swap); cache-on-empty-live; cache-on-raise; degrade-no-cache; no-NSE-equities skip; malformed header (raises before NTM); empty CSV; concurrency (the existing lock-serialisation probe still holds — NIFTY-only master, no network). **Failure modes:** niftyindices timeout/bot-block (`OSError` → cache or honest degrade), empty/garbage CSV (parsed → 0 matches, no crash), partial coverage (unmatched constituents reported, never invented). **Real-run proof (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv + Rust kernels built):** `pytest tests/unit/test_dashboard_instrument_loader.py tests/integration/test_instrument_loader_economics.py` **14 passed**, `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py` **100.00% line+branch (89 stmts / 12 branches, 0 missed)**; broad regression (nse_constituents, ntm_cache, universe_constituents, universe, universe_query, universe routes, app_backfill, cli_run, auto_pull, explorer-store, universe-constituents integration, smoke) **319 passed**; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` **exit 0**; `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` clean; `mypy --strict` + `pyright` **0 errors**; `interrogate` **100%**. **Rollback:** revert this single-file change + its tests + these doc edits; the lake heals on the next keyless load (full-snapshot replace). **Out of scope (other sessions own):** `adapters/groww/adapter.py` internals, `dashboard/app.py` route handlers, any new adapter package. **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) **network timeout** → cache fallback / honest degrade; (2) **empty/garbage CSV** → 0 matches, no crash; (3) **no cache + dead source** → base-set degrade with `reason`; (4) **partial coverage** → unmatched reported, never invented; (5) **concurrent loads** → module `_LOAD_LOCK` serialises (probe test); (6) **idempotent re-pull** → full-snapshot replace, deterministic; (7) **F&O ↔ reference collision** → F&O constituents excluded from the reference set (keep options). **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit + integration + property (resolver invariants in `test_universe_constituents`) + golden (constituent-CSV parse fixtures) + bench (O(1) per-lookup resolver) + stress (lock-serialisation probe) + the audit-log line on the load (`universe.load.ntm_admitted` / `_skipped`). **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — REFACTOR/compliance tier, 1–2 agent):** Explore mapped every caller (frontend reads only `index_count`/`stock_count`; CLI/app tests monkeypatch the loader; the two real-loader test files are owned here) + the store's `fno_eligible_underlyings` "every persisted EQ" mechanism that makes ~750 automatic; Plan stress-tested the design (NTM-index discovery deliberately NOT reimplemented — that lives in the adapter package this session does not own, and the constituents define NTM, not the vendor index row). **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ NTM ~750 admission re-enabled on Groww with 100% module line+branch + all 7 test types' offline scenarios; ✅ brute-force scope provably unchanged (reference-only constituents excluded from the engine, India-VIX tag preserved); 🟡 the LIVE niftyindices fetch (`nse_constituents._default_opener`) stays `# pragma: no cover` — NSE bot-blocks the CI host, so the live path runs only on the operator's Mac (the constituent COUNT/coverage is therefore operator-environment-dependent — a probe gate, NOT a fabricated number — Golden Rule #1); 🟡 standalone `pylint` shows 2 advisory hints (too-many-locals 18/15 on the orchestrator + the deliberate lazy import) in the project-relaxed PLR/PLC0415 families — the ENFORCED linter (ruff's `PL` subset) is clean. **Files:** `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py` (+ tests `tests/unit/test_dashboard_instrument_loader.py`, `tests/integration/test_instrument_loader_economics.py`); CLAUDE.md §3 (DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001 amendment) + §6 universe-count wording updated under this DEC. **Builds on:** DEC-NIFTY-TOTAL-MARKET-LOAD-001 (retired — semantics mirrored) · DEC-NIFTY-TOTAL-MARKET-MAP-001 (`resolve_constituents`) · DEC-NTM-CONSTITUENT-CACHE-001 · DEC-NIFTY-TOTAL-MARKET-REFTAG-001 · DEC-OPTIONS-PULL-GUARD-001 · DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001 · DEC-ZERO-DHAN-SCRUB-001 (#693).
696a. **DEC-GROWW-RATE-PERMIN-001 — the per-minute request governor for Groww backtesting: a HARD 500/min rolling-window cap added to the adaptive `RateController`, operator-confirmed, on top of the existing per-second token bucket** (2026-06-13; renumbered #694 → #696 by parallel-rule P-1 — two Wave-1 PRs merged into main before this one: DEC-NTM-GROWW-REPOINT-001 (#655) claimed #694 and DEC-SYNTHETIC-ADAPTER-001 (#656) claimed #695). **Why:** the `RateController` (`brutex/adapters/rate_common.py`) paced per-SECOND (the adaptive AIMD token bucket) and per-DAY (`DailyQuotaTracker`) but had NO per-minute dimension — so at the Groww-injected ceiling (`GROWW_RATE_LIMIT_RPS_UNVERIFIED=10` r/s) it could issue up to 600/min, overshooting the real backtesting limit. **The real limits (operator-confirmed 2026-06-13, NOT vendor-documented):** Groww backtesting `get_historical_candles` allows **500 requests/minute** with **NO daily quota**. The published SDK "Live Data" group (`docs/groww/api-reference/01-introduction.md:130-134`) lists 10 r/s · 300/min, but that row is NOT confirmed to cover backtesting; the backtesting endpoint is the operator-confirmed 500/min. **What shipped:** a new injected `ceiling_per_min: int | None = None` param on `RateController` (default `None` = governor OFF = byte-for-byte backward-compatible — only the per-second bucket gates); a rolling-60s issue deque + an `_governor_wait_locked` helper; `pace()` rewritten as TWO sequenced gates (per-minute governor → per-second bucket), the controller lock RELEASED before every sleep (mirrors the bucket's compute-under-lock/sleep-outside pattern, CLAUDE.md §11 COMMON — no lock held across a sleep, no dual-bucket serialisation) and a `_GOVERNOR_LOOP_CAP=64` fail-open re-check loop (mirrors the bucket's acquire cap); `snapshot()` gains `recent_minute` + `ceiling_per_min` gauges; new `GROWW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN=500` (honesty-stamped, operator-confirmed) in `brutex/adapters/groww/constants.py`, injected at the two live Groww construction sites (`cli.py` `brutex fetch`, `dashboard/pull_controller.py` `_build_live_controller`). **Orthogonality:** the per-minute cap and the per-second AIMD ladder share NO mutable state — a 429/timeout step-down lowers `_rps` but never touches the cap, and a recovery step-up never raises it (a true fixed ceiling). **Boundary correctness:** eviction + the wait use the SAME `(oldest + WINDOW) - now <= 0` arithmetic so float rounding at the exact 60s edge can never admit a cap+1 overshoot (a real bug caught + fixed in dev — the strict `<` boundary momentarily held cap+1, proven by the `test_cap_binds_over_high_rps` case + property P-19). **Verified (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv):** the per-module `--cov=brutex.adapters.rate_common --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100` gate **100.00% (130 stmts/34 branches, 0 missed), 48 passed**; new `TestPerMinuteGovernor` (9 cases: disabled / empty-window / at-cap-block / window-roll / loop-cap-fail-open / orthogonal-to-stepdown / snapshot-evict / cap-binds-over-high-rps + the direct helper) + property **P-19** (`tests/property/test_rate_limiter_properties.py` — over arbitrary cap/call-count, no rolling-60s window ever exceeds the cap); `ruff` + `ruff format --check` + `mypy --strict` + `pyright` (0 errors) + `vulture --min-confidence 80` clean; full `tests/unit tests/integration tests/property` aggregate green at `--cov-fail-under=100`. **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ the governor is a HARD per-minute cap that only ever LOWERS the issue rate — never raises a ceiling, so it needs no approval (CLAUDE.md §2 Rule 6); ✅ 500/min is operator-confirmed (provenance recorded as operator-stated, NOT a fabricated probe transcript nor a doc citation); ✅ the per-SECOND ceiling stays `_UNVERIFIED` (10 r/s) — 500/min (≈8.3 r/s sustained) is the binding limit anyway; 🟡 the governor's fail-OPEN loop-cap admits at most one extra request under a pathological FROZEN clock (mirrors the bucket; never hangs a worker) — harmless on any real advancing clock; 🟡 the network pull it paces is NOT O(1) — only the governor (per-pace amortized O(1) deque evict + append) + the bucket are O(1); 🟡 the phantom 100,000/day `DailyQuotaTracker` on the dashboard path (Groww backtesting has NO daily quota) is a SEPARATE follow-up PR — kept out to keep this change focused on the per-minute cap. The Z+ resilience matrix + 7-layer audit + the Plan + Explore deep-research hostile-review pass are recorded for the migration in ADR-0009 (DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001), inherited here. **Builds on:** DEC-NTM-GROWW-REPOINT-001 (#694) · DEC-SYNTHETIC-ADAPTER-001 (#695, the two parallel Wave-1 PRs that took #694/#695) · DEC-ZERO-DHAN-SCRUB-001 (#693) · DEC-DHAN-NEUTRAL-RELOCATE-001 (#687, the `rate_common` home) · DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001 (#667, ADR-0009).

695. **DEC-SYNTHETIC-ADAPTER-001 — K2: a SYNTHETIC, deterministic, OFFLINE market adapter (`brutex/adapters/synthetic/`) so the engine + ingest + dashboard run end-to-end with NO Groww creds and NO network** (2026-06-13). **What was added (NEW files only — the Groww adapter, dashboard, and `universe.py` are untouched):** a 5-module package `brutex/adapters/synthetic/` — `constants.py` (honesty-critical identity `market_id="synthetic"` / `display_name="SYNTHETIC (offline, deterministic — NOT real market data)"` + the fixed synthetic universe spec table + generator tuning constants), `generator.py` (the pure, seeded, O(1)-per-bar candle maths), `instruments.py` (the O(1) `SyntheticInstrumentIndex` built DIRECTLY from the spec table — no CSV, no network), `adapter.py` (`SyntheticMarketAdapter` + `SYNTHETIC_CAPABILITIES`, mirroring the `GrowwMarketAdapter` public surface — `capabilities`/`list_instruments`/`list_derivatives`/`fetch_ohlcv`), and `__init__.py`. **Determinism (Golden Rule #4/#7):** every bar is derived from a stable `hashlib.blake2b` digest of `(seed, symbol, …)` — NOT Python's salted `hash()`, NOT a global RNG, NO wall-clock read — so the same `(seed, symbol, interval, start, end)` yields BIT-IDENTICAL bars across processes/interpreter restarts (proven by a fresh-subprocess determinism test + a pinned golden sha256). The seed is an explicit injected `int` field (default `DEFAULT_SEED`), never read from env/time. **O(1) per bar:** a bar at timestamp `ts` is derived ONLY from its absolute minute ordinal (O(1) from `ts`) via a FIXED-octave (constant `NOISE_OCTAVES=5`) smooth value-noise — no scan of prior bars anywhere; a bench gate asserts per-bar cost is flat in BOTH timestamp-position (a 2099 bar costs the same as a 2021 bar) AND batch-size, routed through the shared `tests/bench/_o1_tiers.ratio_ceiling` tier. **OHLC + tick-grid:** prices are exact `Decimal` rupees snapped to the 2dp grid via `brutex.money.round_money` (`ROUND_HALF_UP`); after snapping, `high`/`low` are clamped to bound `open`/`close` (the same correct bound `assemble_candle` uses) so every `CandleBar` invariant holds by construction. Index bars carry zero volume + `open_interest=None`; the lone synthetic equity carries a deterministic non-negative volume. **Honesty (Golden Rule #1/#10):** the bars are GENERATED — `market_id`/`display_name`/docstrings say so plainly; the package is spot-only (`has_derivatives=False`, `list_derivatives` empty), mirroring Track-1 scope (CLAUDE.md §3). **Reuse (§11 COMMON — no copy-paste):** consumes `round_money`, the NSE/BSE `brutex.calendars` session gate (regular/Muhurat/special-weekend windows, 09:15-IST session start), `CandleBar`, and `single_instrument_page`. It deliberately does NOT fork the existing thin dry-run `synthetic_spot_bars`/`SyntheticSpotAdapter` in `ingest_common.py` (a fixed 5-bar single-day ramp under `market_id="spot"`); this is a seeded, multi-symbol (NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/SENSEX + one labelled synthetic equity), multi-interval (1m/5m/15m/1h/1d), arbitrary-range generator under the DISTINCT `market_id="synthetic"` namespace (avoiding the `"spot"` coverage-key collision). **Tests (all 7 types):** unit (`tests/unit/test_synthetic_adapter.py` — drives 100% line+branch of the package), property (`tests/property/test_synthetic_properties.py` — hypothesis over random seed/symbol/interval/range: idempotence, OHLC/2dp/UTC/in-session/ascending invariants, volume semantics, seed-divergence + a cross-process subprocess determinism proof), golden (`tests/golden/test_synthetic_golden.py` — pinned sha256 of the canonical NIFTY 2021-01-04 day, 375 bars), bench (`tests/bench/test_synthetic_o1.py` — the two O(1) ratio gates), stress (`tests/stress/test_synthetic_sustained.py` — long multi-month sweep, all-valid + idempotent resume, env-tunable `SYNTHETIC_STRESS_DAYS`), integration (`tests/integration/test_synthetic_end_to_end.py` — drives the REAL vendor-neutral `run_groww_spot_ingest` spine fully offline through the real session filter + a real `BarSink`), and mutation (the invariant + golden tests kill arithmetic/constant/boundary mutants by construction). **Verified (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv):** package gate `--cov=brutex.adapters.synthetic --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100` exit 0 → **100.00% (189 stmts / 20 branches, 0 missed)**; full `tests/unit` **5630 passed / 4 pre-existing skips** (after building the `fno_math`+`trading_core` kernels), `tests/property`/`golden`/`integration`/`smoke` all green; `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` clean (package + tests); `mypy --strict brutex/adapters/synthetic` clean; `pyright` 0 errors; `bandit -r` 0 issues; `interrogate --fail-under=100` = 100.0%; `vulture --min-confidence 80` no findings; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` exit 0. **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ a fully-offline, seeded, reproducible spot adapter satisfying the `MarketAdapter` protocol, end-to-end-proven through the real ingest spine; ✅ O(1) PER BAR (per-bar generation only — a full multi-year fetch is O(total bars), the inherent cost, NOT an O(1)-total claim); ✅ the data is SYNTHETIC and labelled as such everywhere — it must NEVER be presented as real market data (code/docs/dashboard); 🟡 OPERATOR-FACING WIRING IS DEFERRED to a separate PR — no central adapter registry / env-var selector exists and the CLI/dashboard adapter selection is hardcoded in files this PR does not own (the dashboard is forbidden; `cli.py` is editable but high-blast-radius), so a `--synthetic` operator switch is out of scope here; "run end-to-end offline" is DELIVERED + proven via the integration test driving the real spine, not via a new operator command; 🟡 `earliest_history` is clamped to `2021-01-01` (the verified NSE/BSE calendar horizon) — requests past the calendar coverage are out of scope; 🟡 the package is NOT added to the CI per-module mutation matrix (which by repo convention covers only `orchestrator.state` + `data.money`) — mutation strength is carried by the golden + exhaustive-invariant tests. **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9):** Plan (generator design) + Explore (CI/gate map) + general-purpose (consumption/scope/wiring hostile review) run in PARALLEL before code; their findings (pick a fresh `market_id`, do not fork `synthetic_spot_bars`, defer operator wiring, anchor bars at 09:15 IST so the session filter keeps them, reach 100% with zero `# pragma: no cover`) are folded into this implementation. **Builds on:** DEC-VENDOR-PIVOT-001 (the broker-neutral protocol + dry-run/offline philosophy, ADR-0001) · DEC-ZERO-DHAN-SCRUB-001 (#693) · DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001 (#667, ADR-0009).

696b. **DEC-GROWW-LEG-ECONOMICS-001 — stamp each Groww underlying with its tradable F&O lot + freeze from its legs (close the vendor parity gap + a latent auto-heal reload loop)** (2026-06-13). The Dhan→Groww cutover deliberately did NOT port the retired-vendor `DEC-UNDERLYING-LEG-ECONOMICS-001` lot/freeze fold (it was marked "no Groww twin" — the cutover author had not yet verified the Groww contract-economics shape). **Verified here:** the Groww 21-column instrument master carries `lot_size` + `freeze_quantity` on every row INCLUDING the FUT/CE/PE legs (`adapters/groww/constants.py`, `adapters/groww/instruments.py`), so the data is real — porting reads vendor data, not folklore (Golden Rule #1). **What changed (ONE production file — `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py`):** after the lean set is selected, `load_instrument_master` harvests the per-underlying economics once via the COMMON `universe.build_underlying_economics(index.universe)` (previously DEFINED + exported but UNCALLED in the live Groww path — effectively dead) and folds them with the new `_fold_leg_economics` helper: each underlying with a derivative leg has its `lot_size` + `sm_freeze_qty` SUPERSEDED by the leg's (RELIANCE → 500, NIFTY → 75), while the row's own `tick_size` is PRESERVED (a spot tick differs from its future's). A non-F&O underlying (reference-only NTM constituent / non-F&O index) has no leg → unchanged; a leg without its own freeze leaves the row's freeze intact; the leg `lot_size` is always > 0 (`Instrument.__post_init__` enforces it for every FUT/CE/PE) so a folded equity can never violate the `lot_size > 0` invariant (no dead guard). **Bug fixed (found by the "check everything" pass):** without the fold every F&O equity kept the master's placeholder `lot_size = 1`, which left `InstrumentStore.has_placeholder_stock_economics()` PERMANENTLY True → `auto_pull.should_reload_instrument_master(stale_economics=True)` → the dashboard re-loaded the instrument master on EVERY startup, a silent reload loop; the fold lifts every F&O equity above lot 1 and closes it (asserted). **No downstream breakage (verified):** the options track sizes/costs from its own authoritative `brutex.options.lot_size_history` (an 8-transition history), NOT the instrument-store lot, so folding the store lot does not affect Track-2 costs; the DB viewer simply displays the (now-correct) F&O lot. **Scenarios covered (offline, fakes injected — happy/edge/empty/failure/concurrent):** F&O equity folds to its leg lot+freeze (RELIANCE 500/10000); F&O index folds to its FUT-leg lot+freeze (NIFTY 75/1800, first-leg-wins); leg with blank freeze → equity keeps its own freeze (WIPRO → lot 1500, freeze None); non-F&O index keeps lot 0 (BANKNIFTY); reference-only NTM constituent keeps cash lot 1; idempotent re-ingest yields the same folded values; concurrency probe (NIFTY-only, no legs) unaffected; `has_placeholder_stock_economics()` is False post-load (loop closed). **Failure modes:** none introduced — the fold is a pure in-memory transform of already-validated `Instrument`s; a malformed 0-lot leg is impossible (parser fails closed via `__post_init__`). **Real-run proof (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv + Rust kernels built):** `pytest tests/unit/test_dashboard_instrument_loader.py tests/integration/test_instrument_loader_economics.py` **15 passed**, `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py` **100.00% line+branch (102 stmts / 16 branches, 0 missed)**, `interrogate` **100%**; broad regression (universe, auto_pull, universe_query, universe routes, explorer-store, cli_run) **160 passed**; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` **exit 0**; `ruff` + `ruff format --check` + `mypy --strict` + `pyright` clean. **Rollback:** revert this single-file change + its test updates + the doc edits; the lake heals on the next keyless load (full-snapshot replace, idempotent). **Out of scope (other sessions own):** `adapters/groww/adapter.py` internals, `dashboard/app.py` route handlers, any new adapter package; nearest-expiry leg selection (the fold uses `build_underlying_economics` first-leg-wins, which equals the per-underlying lot since lot/freeze are stable across a snapshot's expiries — a refinement, not a gap). **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) live source down → N/A (no network in this path); (2) malformed leg → impossible (parser fails closed); (3) non-F&O underlying → unchanged; (4) no fabrication → reads real vendor lot/freeze; (5) concurrent loads → existing `_LOAD_LOCK` unaffected; (6) idempotent re-ingest → deterministic folded values; (7) downstream costs → unaffected (options use `lot_size_history`). **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit + integration + property (`build_underlying_economics` invariants in `test_universe`) + golden (canned master CSV) + bench (O(1) dict lookup per underlying) + stress (re-ingest determinism) + audit-log (the existing `universe.load.groww` line). **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — refactor tier, 1-agent):** Explore mapped every consumer of underlying `lot_size`/`sm_freeze_qty` (options track uses its own history; DB viewer only displays) and surfaced the latent auto-heal reload loop; confirmed `Instrument` is `frozen=True, slots=True` so `dataclasses.replace` is the correct mutation, and `__post_init__` accepts the folded values (IDX lot ≥ 0, EQ lot > 0, tick preserved). **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ vendor-parity F&O lot/freeze restored on Groww with 100% module line+branch + the auto-heal loop closed; ✅ no downstream breakage (options costs unaffected); 🟡 first-leg-wins (not nearest-expiry) lot selection — equal to the per-underlying lot within a snapshot, a deliberate reuse of the existing COMMON helper; 🟡 the real live lot/freeze VALUES are validated by the operator's actual Groww master (tests use canned fixtures) — the documented schema (`lot_size`/`freeze_quantity` columns) is the verified basis. **Files:** `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py` (+ tests `tests/unit/test_dashboard_instrument_loader.py`, `tests/integration/test_instrument_loader_economics.py`); CLAUDE.md §3 (DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001 amendment) leg-economics note. **Decision ID:** DEC-GROWW-LEG-ECONOMICS-001. **Builds on:** DEC-UNDERLYING-LEG-ECONOMICS-001 (retired-vendor — semantics mirrored) · DEC-UNDERLYING-ECONOMICS-001 (`build_underlying_economics`) · DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001 · DEC-NTM-GROWW-REPOINT-001 (#694).

702. **DEC-GROWW-OPTION-INGEST-001 — K1: the Groww OPTION INGEST path — `get_expiries` → `get_contracts` → option candles → the standard lake sink** (2026-06-13; renumbered #697 → #702 by parallel-rule P-1 after merging origin/main — PRs #657/#659/#660/#662 claimed #697-#701). **Why:** the Groww adapter shipped spot-only — `GrowwMarketAdapter.list_derivatives` was an empty iterator and there was NO way to pull the F&O option chain into the lake (DEC-P0-063 expanded the LAKE to options as REFERENCE_ONLY, but the Groww ingest leg was never built; the retired-vendor `option_ingest.py` was deleted in the J4 series and was modelled on a rolling/relative-strike API that does NOT match Groww). **Key finding (4-agent hostile review, Plan + 2× general-purpose/Explore in parallel — CLAUDE.md §9):** Groww options are ABSOLUTE-strike OHLCV+OI rows (all listed strikes, `docs/groww/api-reference/03-backtesting.md:202-236`), so they ride the SAME standard `BarSink` / `CandleBar` / `bars/<exch>/FNO/<contract_groww_symbol>/<interval>/<yyyy>/<mm>.parquet` path as spot (`brutex/data/partition.py` explicitly supports `FNO` + hyphenated contract symbols) — NOT the orphaned relative/rolling option schema (Golden Rule #1 — no invented vendor shape). The option legs are DISCARDED from the lean universe (DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001), so the spot index-resolve `fetch_ohlcv` cannot fetch a contract — the option path fetches INDEX-FREE. `has_derivatives` has NO live consumer (it does not auto-trigger a phase), so the scope guard is held by convention (never feed options into the brute-force instrument list), and `GROWW_CAPABILITIES.has_derivatives` STAYS `False` (it describes the brute-force ENGINE scope, not the Groww market). **What shipped (NEW files in `brutex/adapters/groww/` + adapter edits — no dashboard/cli touched):** `candles.py` (`fetch_candle_windows` — the ONE shared tile→fetch→parse primitive both spot `fetch_ohlcv` and the option path call, CLAUDE.md §11 COMMON); `contracts.py` (`parse_contract_symbol` — right-anchored CE/PE/FUT + Decimal strike + authoritative expiry; `resolve_expiries` / `resolve_contracts` / `option_contracts` / `enumerate_contracts`); `option_ingest.py` (`fetch_option_candles` index-free FNO `drop_volume=False`; `ingest_option_contract` per-contract spine — ledger skip+record, current-day clamp, session filter, bounded transient retry, terminal propagation, conflict summary; `run_groww_option_ingest` sequential paced multi-contract driver with per-pair quarantine + aggregate report; `ingest_underlying_options` the full expiries→contracts→CE/PE→lake path); `adapter.py` (`list_derivatives` fleshed out to enumerate the LAKE chain across `EARLIEST_HISTORY..current year`; `fetch_ohlcv` refactored onto `fetch_candle_windows`); `client.py` (`expiries` `year`/`month` now OPTIONAL, OMITTED from the SDK call when `None` — one call per historical year); `constants.py` (`OPTION_SEGMENT="FNO"` + `GROWW_OPTION_COVERAGE_MARKET="groww-option"`, distinct from the spot `"groww"` namespace). **Pacing (DEC-GROWW-RATE-PERMIN-001 / DEC-DHAN-RATE-SINGLE-BUCKET-001):** every physical call rides the injected `pace` hook — the SAME shared `RateController` (one bucket + 500/min governor) the spot pull uses; pacing is NOT reinvented. **Scope (CLAUDE.md §3):** option bars are LAKE / REFERENCE_ONLY — NEVER the brute-force engine or the 52-condition vocabulary. **Verified (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv + `fno_math`+`trading_core` Rust kernels built):** per-module `--cov=...candles,contracts,option_ingest,adapter,client,constants --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100` → **100.00% (334 stmts / 74 branches, 0 missed)**, **84 new/updated cases passed**; full `tests/unit tests/property tests/golden tests/integration tests/stress` aggregate **6405 passed / 36 pre-existing skips** (no regression from the `adapter.py`/`client.py` refactor — all 88 prior groww/adapter/protocol cases green); `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` clean; `mypy --strict` + `pyright` 0 errors; `bandit -r` 0 issues; `interrogate --fail-under=100` = 100.0%; `vulture --min-confidence 80` clean; `jscpd` (brutex, 3% gate) → the option spine added **ZERO clones** (overall 0.93%); `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` exit 0. **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) live source down → terminal `GrowwError` quarantines the `(contract,interval)` pair, run continues; (2) malformed contract symbol / expiry → `parse_contract_symbol`/`resolve_*` fail LOUD (`ValueError`, never a silent skip); (3) transient 429/timeout → bounded in-run retry then deferred UNMARKED (no-mask), the controller is fed (`on_rate_limit`/`on_timeout`); (4) no fabrication → all facts file:line-traced to `03-backtesting.md` + repo; (5) idempotent re-pull → settled windows SKIPPED via the unified `WindowLedger`, keep-first sink absorbs dups (proven at N=2000 + via a REAL `ParquetBarSink`); (6) auth death mid-pull → quarantined with `auth_failure=True` → `report.auth_aborted` (a future auto-retry halts); (7) non-Groww exception (a real bug) → NEVER swallowed (re-raised). **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit (`test_groww_contracts`/`_candles`/`_option_ingest` + updated `_adapter`/`_client`) + integration (`test_groww_option_ingest_pipeline` — real lake) + property (`test_groww_contract_symbol_properties` — Hypothesis round-trip/right-anchored/fail-loud) + golden (`test_groww_option_chain_golden` — byte-frozen resolved chain) + bench (`test_groww_contract_parse_o1` — O(1) parse, measured 1.02×) + stress (`test_groww_option_ingest_sustained` — N=2000 + idempotent re-pull) + mutation (the invariant + golden + per-branch error cases kill arithmetic/constant/boundary mutants by construction). **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ the offline code + injected fakes reach 100% line+branch with ZERO `# pragma: no cover`; ✅ the LIVE pull needs real Groww creds + network (operator-run) — full contract validation (real expiry/strike shapes) is a Phase-0 probe gate, NOT proven here; ✅ O(1) per parse / per ledger op / per pace — but a contract fetch tiles its range and the drivers are O(contracts × windows), network-bound, NOT O(1)-total; 🟡 the multi-contract driver is SEQUENTIAL (paced — the bucket is the governor, not the worker count); PARALLEL outer fan-out (the spot path's `PoolRunParallel`) + the dashboard/cli `run_two_phase` wiring (currently defined-but-unwired) are a K2 concern, out of scope here; 🟡 the orphaned retired-vendor rolling-option lake (`option_parquet_writer`/`option_sink`, `OptionBar` with `spot`/`iv`) is NOT used — Groww options write the standard `BarSink`; surfacing them on the dashboard `/coverage` is K2's call. **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — major change, parallel pre-code):** Plan (module layout) + general-purpose (design-tension stress-test: `has_derivatives` consumers, protocol invariants, index-free fetch, client `month`-optional, symbol edge cases, shared pacing) + Explore (consumption-surface map: deleted-vendor blueprint, `run_two_phase` wiring, option lake/coverage scheme, dashboard contracts) run in parallel BEFORE code; findings folded in (standard `BarSink` not the rolling schema, index-free fetch, keep `has_derivatives=False`, parse-from-the-right + authoritative expiry, reuse the one `RateController`). **Incidental ledger repair:** the pre-existing `#696`×2 collision on `main` (two merged Wave PRs — DEC-GROWW-RATE-PERMIN-001 #654 and DEC-GROWW-LEG-ECONOMICS-001 #658 — both claimed #696, leaving the `validate_ledger_numbering` gate RED on main) is disambiguated with the script's sanctioned, citation-PRESERVING letter suffixes → `696a` / `696b` (an "entry #696" citation still lands on the small `{696a,696b}` candidate set; no cross-reference orphaned). **Files:** `brutex/adapters/groww/{candles,contracts,option_ingest}.py` (new) + `{adapter,client,constants}.py` (edits); `tests/unit/test_groww_{contracts,candles,option_ingest,adapter,client}.py`, `tests/property/test_groww_contract_symbol_properties.py`, `tests/golden/test_groww_option_chain_golden.py`, `tests/bench/test_groww_contract_parse_o1.py`, `tests/stress/test_groww_option_ingest_sustained.py`, `tests/integration/test_groww_option_ingest_pipeline.py`. **Decision ID:** DEC-GROWW-OPTION-INGEST-001. **Builds on:** DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001 (#667, ADR-0009) · DEC-P0-063 (option LAKE / REFERENCE_ONLY) · DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001 (legs discarded → index-free fetch) · DEC-GROWW-RATE-PERMIN-001 (#696a, the shared `RateController` pacing) · DEC-WINDOW-LEDGER-001 (the skip/record authority).

699. **DEC-GROWW-CREDS-TEST-IMPORT-400-001 — the Groww creds Test/verify endpoint returns a clean 400 "install `.[groww]`" instead of a raw 500 when the optional extra is missing** (2026-06-13). The tracked UX follow-up from DEC-ZERO-DHAN-SCRUB-001 (#693): the dashboard `POST /api/v1/groww/credentials/test` route runs the live Phase-0 probe via `build_live_client`, which **lazily imports the optional `.[groww]` extra** (`pyotp` + `growwapi`) inside `get_access_token` / the SDK factory. When that extra is NOT installed, the raw `ModuleNotFoundError` escaped the route's except chain (which only caught `GrowwAuthError`→400 / `GrowwError`→502) as an unhandled **HTTP 500**, which the frontend mis-rendered as "not valid JSON". **What changed (ONE production file — `brutex/dashboard/app.py`):** the route's `_run()` now catches `ImportError` (a superclass of `ModuleNotFoundError`, so it also covers a broken/partial install) and returns a clean **400** with an actionable detail — "Groww live probe needs the optional dependencies — install them with `pip install -e '.[groww]'` (growwapi + pyotp). (<exc>)" — placed BEFORE the `GrowwAuthError`/`GrowwError` clauses (the lazy import fires first, and `ImportError` is unrelated to the Groww error tree). `str(exc)` is only "No module named '…'" — never a secret. **Scenarios covered (offline, fakes injected — happy/edge/empty/failure):** missing extra → 400 naming `.[groww]` + the module (new `test_test_route_missing_groww_extra_400`, monkeypatching `build_live_client` to raise `ModuleNotFoundError`); the existing success / missing-creds-400 / auth-fail-400-redacted / other-GrowwError-502 branches are unchanged + still green; the secret-leak guard asserts the api key / TOTP secret never appear in the response. **Failure modes:** the broader `ImportError` catch is scoped to the `build_live_client`/`run_probe` block whose ONLY failable imports are the optional growwapi/pyotp deps (all other imports are stdlib/brutex, already loaded), so it cannot mask an unrelated bug. **Real-run proof (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv + Rust kernels):** `pytest tests/unit/test_dashboard_groww_credentials_route.py` **10 passed** (incl. the new test); the new `except ImportError` branch is COVERED (line 2224, inside the covered endpoint region — not in the missing-lines list); broad dashboard regression (app_backfill, universe routes/query/ux/template, auto_pull, instruments + universe-constituents integration) **127 passed**; `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` + `mypy --strict` clean on `app.py`; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` **exit 0**. **Rollback:** revert the single-file change + the one new test. **Out of scope (other sessions own):** the rest of `dashboard/app.py`, the Groww adapter internals, any new adapter package; the actual `pyotp`/`growwapi` install (operator action). **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) extra missing → clean 400 (not 500); (2) broken/partial install → same 400 (ImportError superclass); (3) creds missing → 400 (unchanged); (4) auth failure → 400 redacted (unchanged); (5) other Groww error → 502 (unchanged); (6) secret leak → none (guard asserts); (7) success path → 200 (unchanged). **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit (the new + existing route tests) + integration (TestClient through the real app) + property (n/a — branch logic) + golden (n/a) + bench (n/a — error path) + stress (n/a) + audit (the route's existing structlog). **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — refactor tier, 1-agent):** Explore confirmed the import-firing point (`build_live_client` → `get_access_token` → lazy `pyotp`/`growwapi`), that `ImportError` here is always the optional-extra (no other failable import in the block), and the existing test harness (`_save` + `_patch_probe`) covers the new branch. **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ a missing/broken `.[groww]` extra now yields a clean, actionable 400 (no more raw-500 "not valid JSON"), the new branch covered, no existing branch changed; ✅ no secret leak (guarded); 🟡 the LIVE probe success path still needs the operator's real creds + the `.[groww]` extra (this PR only fixes the missing-deps ERROR surface, not the probe itself — that is the operator's Phase-0 run). **Files:** `brutex/dashboard/app.py` (+ test `tests/unit/test_dashboard_groww_credentials_route.py`). **Decision ID:** DEC-GROWW-CREDS-TEST-IMPORT-400-001. **Builds on:** DEC-ZERO-DHAN-SCRUB-001 (#693, the tracked follow-up) · DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001 (#667, ADR-0009) · DEC-CREDS-422-FIX-001.

700. **DEC-GROWW-NO-DAILY-QUOTA-001 — drop the phantom 100,000/day quota from the dashboard Groww pull (Groww backtesting has no daily quota; match the already-merged CLI path)** (2026-06-13). **Why:** `brutex/dashboard/pull_controller.py` `_build_live_controller` wired a `DailyQuotaTracker()` (the persisted 100,000/day cap, DEC-AUTO-RESUME-QUOTA-001) into the live `RateController` — but Groww backtesting `get_historical_candles` has **NO daily quota** (operator-confirmed 2026-06-13; the published 100k/day figure is the general/Live-Data API, NOT confirmed for backtesting), so that internal cap would WRONGLY HALT a large multi-day backfill (e.g. the full option-chain pull, which exceeds 100k calls/day). The already-merged CLI Groww spot path (`cli.py`) already builds the controller with `quota_tracker=None`; this aligns the dashboard with it. **What changed (ONE production file — `brutex/dashboard/pull_controller.py`):** `_build_live_controller` now returns `RateController(ceiling_per_min=GROWW_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN)` with NO `DailyQuotaTracker` (the import dropped); the 500/min per-minute governor (DEC-GROWW-RATE-PERMIN-001, #696) + the adaptive per-second bucket remain the live pacing gates; the docstring rewritten to state the operator-confirmed no-daily-quota fact. **Consequence (no breakage):** the controller's `quota_exhausted()` is always `False` (no tracker), so the auto-resume `stop_quota` branch is DORMANT for the dashboard pull (it stops on clean/dead/complete instead); the rate panel already hides the quota gauge via its `quota_limit=-1` sentinel when no tracker is wired (no panel change); the separate read-only `/api/v1/quota` endpoint keeps its own informational tracker (display only, no enforcement) — OUT OF SCOPE. **Scenarios covered (offline):** happy (controller built with no tracker → `quota_exhausted` False, snapshot omits quota keys, `ceiling_per_min=500` governor still wired — the regression test `test_default_factory_builds_a_real_controller`); back-compat (a controller built WITH a tracker still enforces — `RateController` unchanged, the quota / `stop_quota` path still 100% covered); the rate-panel `quota_limit=-1` hide-path unchanged. **Failure modes:** none introduced — removing the tracker only removes enforcement; the until-clean loop has other terminal conditions (clean/dead/complete). **Real-run proof (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv):** `pytest --cov=brutex.dashboard.pull_controller --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100 tests/unit/test_dashboard_pull_controller.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_pull_pool_sizing.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_rate_panel.py` → **100.00% (289 stmts / 56 branches, 0 missed), 79 passed**; broad quota/auto-resume/backfill regression (`test_quota_tracker`, `test_ingest_common_until_clean`, `test_dashboard_app_backfill`) **100 passed** (unaffected); full `tests/unit tests/integration tests/property` aggregate **6264 passed at --cov-fail-under=100**; `mypy --strict brutex` clean (212 files); `pyright` 0 errors; `ruff` + `ruff format --check` + `vulture --min-confidence 80` + `interrogate` (exact CI flags, 100%) clean; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` exit 0. **Rollback:** revert this single-file change + the test + this doc edit; the dashboard re-imposes the 100k/day cap. **Out of scope:** the read-only `/api/v1/quota` informational gauge + the dormant `stop_quota` code are LEFT as-is; CLI path already None. No engine / vocabulary / strategy changes (CLAUDE.md §3 scope-lock). **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) Correctness — dashboard pacing = CLI, no daily halt, governor + bucket intact; (2) Reliability — only REMOVES a wrong enforcement, never raises a cap; (3) Recoverability — `git revert`, config-only; (4) Idempotence — pure construction change; (5) Back-compat — `RateController` quota path unchanged + still covered; (6) Observability — `/api/v1/quota` gauge retained; rate panel hides the live gauge via its -1 sentinel; (7) Honest envelope — operator-confirmed fact, not fabricated. **Z+ 7-layer audit:** type (mypy --strict brutex + pyright 0) · lint (ruff + ruff format) · dead-code (vulture) · docstrings (interrogate 100%) · coverage (100% per-module + the regression test + full aggregate) · property/integration (the unaffected quota suite green) · zero-dhan (guard exit 0). **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — refactor/compliance tier):** read the full daily-quota blast radius (pull_controller `_build_live_controller`, the rate-panel `quota_limit=-1` hide-path, `make_rate_observer`, the `/api/v1/quota` endpoint's own tracker, the ingest_common `stop_quota`/`stopped_on_quota` auto-resume path) before the one-line change; confirmed the CLI already uses None + the panel + auto-resume degrade cleanly. The **Z+ 15-row matrix** + the migration-wide review are recorded in ADR-0009 (DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001), inherited here. **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ the dashboard Groww pull no longer imposes a phantom daily cap (matches the CLI; operator-confirmed no daily quota) with 100% per-module line+branch + a regression test; 🟡 the `/api/v1/quota` informational gauge + the dormant `stop_quota` auto-resume code are deliberately LEFT (display/safety scaffolding, no enforcement on the live pull) — a fuller DEC-AUTO-RESUME-QUOTA-001 retirement is out of scope; 🟡 config-only, no hot path, no O(1) claim. **Builds on:** DEC-GROWW-RATE-PERMIN-001 (#696) · DEC-AUTO-RESUME-QUOTA-001 (the quota system this narrows for backtesting) · DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001 (#667, ADR-0009).

701. **DEC-MOVERS-GAINERS-001 (M1) — a top gainers / losers screener CORE (`brutex/screeners/`) that ranks the lake's instruments by % price change over a window** (2026-06-13). **What was added (NEW package only — the brute-force engine, the Groww adapter, and the dashboard are UNTOUCHED):** a 2-module package `brutex/screeners/` — `gainers_losers.py` (the pure ranking core + value objects + the injected-reader Protocol) and `__init__.py` (re-exports). **The surface:** `InstrumentRef` (`symbol`/`exchange`/`segment` + a total-order `sort_key`), `Mover` (`ref`/`base_price`/`last_price`/`pct_change`/`bar_count`), `ScreenResult` (`gainers`/`losers`/`skipped`), the `LakeReader` Protocol (`list_instruments` + `read_window`), the **pure** `rank_movers(movers, *, top_n)`, and the driver `screen_gainers_losers(reader, *, interval, start, end, top_n)`. **% change semantics:** the move is measured first-bar OPEN → last-bar CLOSE (the complete in-window move, well-defined even for a single bar); both endpoint prices are snapped to the 2-decimal rupee grid via `brutex.money.round_money` (DEC-SPOT-PRICE-2DP-001) but the **% change itself keeps full `Decimal` precision and is NEVER money-rounded** (CLAUDE.md §4 — `DEC-MONEY-2DP-001` is display-money-only; the golden test pins the repeating `-66.66…%` as the oracle). **COMMON reuse (CLAUDE.md §11 — no copy-paste / jscpd gate):** the `(value − base)/base × 100` arithmetic is NOT re-implemented — it delegates to the single source of truth `brutex.data.spot_features.pct_change` (DEC-SPOT-PCT-CHANGE-001, entry #346), which also supplies the zero-base guard (a sub-paisa open snapping to 0.00 → instrument skipped, never a division crash); the integration test reuses `brutex.feed.replay._arrow_table_to_bars` for the Arrow→`CandleBar` conversion. **Sign-split (Golden Rule #1):** a gainer must have GAINED (`pct_change > 0`), a loser must have LOST (`< 0`), a flat instrument is in neither — the two lists are disjoint by construction; ties break deterministically on `(symbol, exchange, segment)`. **Efficient lake read (no whole-lake scan):** the injected `LakeReader.read_window` mirrors the lake's own `Catalog.get_bars` (reads ONLY the partitions overlapping `[start, end]` for one instrument); the per-instrument reduction `_build_mover` is **O(1) in the number of window bars** (endpoint-only — first open, last close, count — it never scans the window, proven by the bench ratio gate at 100k vs 1k bars). **Scope (CLAUDE.md §3):** REFERENCE-ONLY over the lake — the brute-force engine + the 52-condition vocabulary are untouched; the screener only reads ingested OHLC and orders it. **Scenarios covered (offline, fake reader — happy/edge/empty/failure/boundary/idempotent):** gainers+losers from a mixed lake; flat ranked-out; empty-window + zero-base skipped (sorted); bars outside the window excluded; `top_n` caps each side independently; `top_n < 1` and `start > end` raise `ValueError`; interval/window propagation asserted; empty lake → empty result; the real-lake integration path (Parquet+DuckDB) ranks NIFTY (+10%) over BANKNIFTY (−10%) and skips an un-ingested SENSEX. **Real-run proof (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv + `fno_math`/`trading_core` Rust kernels built):** per-module gate `pytest --cov=brutex.screeners --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100 tests/unit/test_screeners_gainers_losers.py` → **100.00% line+branch (68 stmts / 14 branches, 0 missed), 27 passed**; the 7 test types green (unit 27 · property 7 hypothesis invariants · golden 2 byte-frozen · bench 3 O(1) · stress 1 @30k instruments · integration 2 real-lake · mutation carried by the boundary/golden tests); `ruff check` + `ruff format --check` clean; `mypy --strict` + `pyright` (strict) **0 errors** on the package + all new tests; `bandit -r` 0 issues; `vulture --min-confidence 80` no findings; `interrogate --fail-under=100` 100.0%; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` exit 0; full `tests/unit tests/integration tests/property` aggregate green (6026 → 6064 passed). **Rollback:** delete the `brutex/screeners/` package + its tests + the CI per-module gate stanza + this ledger entry; nothing else imports it (zero blast radius). **Out of scope (deferred / other sessions own):** the dashboard UI route + the real `LakeReader` wiring over `InstrumentStore`+`Catalog` (a later PR — this ships the CORE + tests only); the M2 session also adds to `brutex/screeners/__init__.py` (keep BOTH exports on merge — trivial conflict); the brute-force engine. **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) empty window → skipped, never ranked; (2) zero/sub-paisa base price → skipped via the COMMON zero-base guard, no crash; (3) bars outside `[start,end]` → excluded (reader mirrors `get_bars`); (4) `top_n < 1` / `start > end` → `ValueError`; (5) flat instrument → in neither list; (6) idempotent re-run → byte-identical `ScreenResult` (Golden Rule #4, stress + golden); (7) instrument absent from lake → reported skipped, never invented (Golden Rule #1). **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit + integration (real Parquet+DuckDB) + property (hypothesis sign/subset/order/cap/determinism invariants) + golden (byte-frozen full-precision screen) + bench (O(1) endpoint-only reduction) + stress (30k-instrument deterministic sweep) + the honest-envelope doc trail. **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — new-module/major tier):** two parallel Explore agents mapped the lake read path (`Catalog.get_bars` → `list_partitions` overlap-only; `_arrow_table_to_bars`) + the house style (frozen/slots dataclasses, NumPy docstrings, Protocol DI, the 7 test-type templates, per-module CI gate pattern) BEFORE code; the design folds their findings (reuse `spot_features.pct_change` not a fresh formula; endpoint-only reduction for the O(1) claim; sign-split for honest naming). **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ a pure, deterministic, 100%-line+branch screener core with all 7 test types + a real-lake integration proof; ✅ O(1) PER INSTRUMENT (endpoint-only reduction) — the WHOLE screen is inherently `O(M·log M)` over `M` instruments (the rank sort) plus one `O(window)` read each, NOT O(1)-total, and the module says so; ✅ it screens the LOCAL lake — results depend entirely on what the operator has ingested; no prices are fabricated (Golden Rule #1); 🟡 NO operator-facing surface yet (dashboard route + real reader deferred to a follow-up PR); 🟡 the package is NOT in the CI per-module mutation matrix (repo convention covers only `orchestrator.state` + `data.money`) — mutation strength is carried by the boundary + golden tests. **Files:** `brutex/screeners/__init__.py`, `brutex/screeners/gainers_losers.py`; tests `tests/unit/test_screeners_gainers_losers.py`, `tests/property/test_screeners_gainers_losers_properties.py`, `tests/golden/test_screeners_gainers_losers_golden.py`, `tests/bench/test_screeners_gainers_losers_o1.py`, `tests/stress/test_screeners_gainers_losers_sustained.py`, `tests/integration/test_screeners_gainers_losers_lake.py`, `tests/fakes/screener_lake.py`; `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (per-module gate 19i2a). **Decision ID:** DEC-MOVERS-GAINERS-001. **Builds on:** DEC-SPOT-PCT-CHANGE-001 (#346, the COMMON `pct_change`) · DEC-MONEY-2DP-001 (`round_money`) · DEC-RANKING-001 (the ranking house style) · DEC-FETCH-ALL-001 (the lake/engine two-tier scope).

703. **DEC-NON-OPTION-INDEX-REFTAG-001 — tag every spot-only index (no listed options, not brute-forced) `reference_only` at ingest so the `/universe` dashboard stops badging non-F&O indices "OPT"** (2026-06-13). **Bug (operator-reported):** after clicking "F&O only" on `/universe`, every index still showed — NIFTY TOTAL MKT, the sectorals (NIFTY IT / AUTO / PHARMA), the broad-market baskets (NIFTY 100 / 500) — all wrongly carrying the green "OPT" (option-pullable) chip. **Root cause:** the badge is `is_option_pullable(instr) = instr.security_id not in reference_only_ids`, and the keyless Groww load only tagged `reference_only` for India VIX (the `is_reference_only` index flag) + the non-F&O NTM constituent STOCKS — it never tagged the non-options INDICES, so they defaulted to pullable. The lean ingest DISCARDS the CE/PE legs (DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001), so options-eligibility is NOT recoverable at query time — it must be harvested at ingest while the legs still exist. **Fix (TWO owned files):** (1) `brutex/universe.py` — a new pure, single-source `is_spot_only_index(instrument, options_eligible)` (CLAUDE.md §11 COMMON): True iff an `IDX` row is NEITHER a brute-force index (NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / SENSEX — `is_in_brute_force_scope`, always individually tradable, the engine-isolation guard wins first so the trio is NEVER reference_only) NOR named by a CE/PE leg in `build_options_eligible_underlyings` (FINNIFTY / MIDCPNIFTY / NIFTY NEXT 50 keep their chain). (2) `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py` — `load_instrument_master` harvests `build_options_eligible_underlyings(index.universe)` from the FULL master (before the legs are dropped) and `_reference_only_of(reference_security_ids, options_eligible)` gains a third arm tagging spot-only indices reference_only — so the badge + the "F&O only" filter are both correct. **Data-driven, no hallucination (Golden Rule #1):** the options set is derived from the vendor's own CE/PE legs, never a hardcoded index list. **Engine-safe:** `is_in_brute_force_scope` is an explicit 3-symbol allow-list (never reads the `reference_only` column — `tests/property/test_engine_isolation.py`), and the brute-force trio is explicitly excluded from the new tag, so the `is_reference_only`/`is_in_brute_force_scope` mutual-exclusivity invariant (DEC-ENGINE-ISOLATION-INVARIANT-001) + the India-VIX golden (`test_india_vix_reference_golden.py`) are untouched. **Backward-compatible:** every pre-existing loader-test fixture contains only brute-force indices + India VIX (already reference), so all stored `reference_only` sets are byte-identical; no existing assertion changed. **Scenarios covered (offline, fakes injected — happy/edge/empty):** sectoral index (NIFTY IT) → reference_only, NOT pullable; options index (FINNIFTY, a CE leg names it) → pullable; the 3 brute-force indices (incl. BSE SENSEX, whose options live outside the NSE-only set) → always pullable; India VIX → reference (both the VIX flag AND the spot-only rule, redundant + harmless); an equity → decided by F&O-eligibility, not this rule. **Failure modes:** none introduced — the predicate is a pure in-memory classifier over already-validated `Instrument`s; computing it from `index.universe` adds one O(n-once) pass that already happens for F&O-eligibility. **Real-run proof (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv + Rust kernels built; 2026-06-13):** `pytest tests/unit/test_universe.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_instrument_loader.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_universe_query.py` + broad regression (universe routes/query/template/ux, app_backfill, engine-isolation property, India-VIX golden, instrument-store integration) **220 passed, 2 skipped**; `brutex/universe.py` **100.00% line+branch (97 stmts / 32 branches, 0 missed)** + `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py` **100.00% line+branch (103 stmts / 16 branches, 0 missed)**; `ruff` + `ruff format --check` + `mypy --strict` + `pyright` (0 errors) + `bandit` + `vulture` clean; `interrogate` (CI flags) **100.0%**; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` **exit 0**. **Rollback:** revert the two production edits + the two test additions (the docstring of `is_option_pullable` + the loader module-doc note). **Out of scope (other sessions own):** `adapters/groww/adapter.py` internals, `dashboard/app.py` route handlers (the route already passes `reference_only_ids` through unchanged — the fix is entirely in what gets PERSISTED as reference_only), any new adapter package; broadening `build_options_eligible_underlyings` to BSE (SENSEX rides the brute-force exclusion, a deliberate reuse, not a gap). **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) legs discarded post-ingest → options set harvested BEFORE the drop; (2) brute-force trio → guard wins first, never reference; (3) options index → kept pullable; (4) no fabrication → vendor CE/PE legs, never a hardcoded list; (5) concurrent loads → the existing `_LOAD_LOCK` covers it (unchanged); (6) idempotent re-ingest → deterministic tag; (7) engine-safe → explicit allow-list unaffected. **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit (`is_spot_only_index` all branches + the loader end-to-end) + integration (the real store round-trips the tag) + property (engine isolation still disjoint) + golden (India-VIX reference unchanged) + bench (O(n-once) pass, no hot-path change) + stress (re-ingest determinism) + audit (the existing `universe.load.groww` line). **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — refactor tier, 1-agent):** Explore traced the badge to `reference_only_ids`, confirmed the legs are discarded (so ingest-time harvest is mandatory), and verified the engine-isolation invariant reads only the explicit allow-list (not the column) so extending the column is safe given the brute-force exclusion. **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ non-F&O indices no longer badge "OPT" + are filtered by "F&O only"; option indices + the brute-force trio keep their chain; both modules at 100% line+branch; 🟡 the displayed state is only as fresh as the last "Load instruments" (the operator's keyless reload re-tags from the current master). **Files:** `brutex/universe.py` + `brutex/dashboard/instrument_loader.py` (+ tests `tests/unit/test_universe.py`, `tests/unit/test_dashboard_instrument_loader.py`). **Decision ID:** DEC-NON-OPTION-INDEX-REFTAG-001. **Builds on:** DEC-OPTIONS-PULL-GUARD-001 (`is_option_pullable`) · DEC-OPTIONS-ELIGIBLE-GUARD-001 (`build_options_eligible_underlyings`) · DEC-NIFTY-TOTAL-MARKET-REFTAG-001 (the reference_only column) · DEC-NTM-GROWW-REPOINT-001 (#694) · DEC-INSTRUMENT-UNIVERSE-FAST-001 (legs discarded) · DEC-ENGINE-ISOLATION-INVARIANT-001.

704. **DEC-DASHBOARD-ECON-COLUMNS-001 — surface each instrument's lot size + freeze quantity + tick size in the `/universe` Instruments column** (2026-06-13). Operator request: SEE the per-symbol contract economics on the dashboard — the F&O lot + freeze folded from the legs at ingest (DEC-GROWW-LEG-ECONOMICS-001) were stored but never displayed. **What changed (ONE helper + the template — `dashboard/universe_query.py` + `templates/universe.html`):** `list_underlyings` now adds `lot_size` (int) / `tick_size` (str — the Decimal serialised exactly, JSON-safe, no float noise) / `freeze_quantity` (int | None) to each explorer row; the `/universe` Instruments column renders a compact `lot · tick · freeze` line under each symbol via a new `econLine()` helper + a `.inst .econ` style, OMITTING absent parts — an index has no lot/freeze (blank line), and a reference-only non-F&O spot row shows only its tick (its lot 1 is a cash placeholder, not a tradable F&O lot). The `/api/v1/universe/instruments` route passes the new fields through unchanged (no route-logic change). **Scenarios covered (offline, fakes injected — happy/edge/empty):** F&O stock row carries lot 500 / tick `"0.10"` / freeze 15001 (a stored, leg-folded equity); an index row carries its placeholder economics with freeze `None`; the exact row-shape is pinned; the rendered page ships `econLine(` + `.inst .econ` + `class="econ"` + the three field reads. **Failure modes:** none — pure-additive dict keys + a display line; `tick_size` is serialised to `str` so `JSONResponse` can never choke on a `Decimal`. **Real-run proof (HONEST — real local runs, 3.12 venv + Rust kernels built):** `pytest tests/unit/test_dashboard_universe_query.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_universe_template.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_universe_routes.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_universe_ux.py` **43 passed**; `brutex/dashboard/universe_query.py` **100.00% line+branch (44 stmts / 20 branches, 0 missed)**, `interrogate` **100%**; broad dashboard regression (routes/query/template/ux/app_backfill + explorer-store integration) **85 passed**; `ruff` + `ruff format --check` + `mypy --strict` clean; `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` **exit 0**. **Rollback:** revert the helper + template + test changes (the route is untouched). **Out of scope (other sessions own):** the rest of `dashboard/app.py` route logic, the Groww adapter; 705. **DEC-MOVERS-VOLUME-001 — a reference-only "volume / volatility movers" screener (`brutex/screeners/volume_movers.py`) ranking the lake's instruments by volume-surge ratio + realised intraday range volatility** (2026-06-13). **What shipped (NEW package only — `brutex/screeners/`; the brute-force engine, the 52-condition vocabulary, `universe.py`, the Groww adapter, and the dashboard are all UNTOUCHED):** a pure ranking core + an injected-reader orchestration. `compute_mover_metrics` derives, per instrument over one window, a **volume-surge ratio** (`mean(recent_volume) / mean(baseline_volume)` — the last `recent_bars` bars vs the bars before them, an RVOL-style relative-volume measure) and a **realised intraday range volatility** (`mean((high - low) / close)` over the positive-close bars — a price-level-independent range proxy). `rank_by_volume_surge` / `rank_by_realised_volatility` return the top-N descending with a STABLE tiebreak by `(exchange, segment, symbol, interval)`; `rank_movers` (pure) assembles a `MoversReport` from a per-instrument OHLCV mapping (empty series → `skipped`, never fabricated); `screen_movers` loads each target's bars through an injected `LakeBarReader` Protocol (the ONLY I/O seam — fakeable in tests; production binds the lake `Catalog`, deferred per the UI-deferred scope). The package `brutex/screeners/__init__.py` re-exports this pure ranker as `rank_volume_movers` (aliased) so it coexists with the gainers/losers screener's `rank_movers` (DEC-MOVERS-GAINERS-001 #701) without a namespace clash. **Scope (CLAUDE.md §3 scope lock, DEC-MOVERS-VOLUME-001):** REFERENCE_ONLY over the lake — screening an F&O-eligible / NIFTY-Total-Market underlying here NEVER admits it to the brute-force engine (mirrors DEC-NTM-GROWW-REPOINT-001). **Determinism (Golden Rule #4/#7):** every metric is computed in a FIXED 28-digit `Decimal` context (immune to the caller's ambient context), so a screen is bit-identical across runs; statistical metrics keep full precision (NOT rounded to the money 2dp grid — DEC-MONEY-2DP-001). **Money (DEC-MONEY-2DP-001):** the lone money surface — the representative `last_close` — routes through `brutex.money` (`rupees_to_paisa` → int64 paisa; `format_inr` for display). **Tests (all 7 types, real local runs, 3.12 venv + Rust kernels built):** per-module `--cov=brutex.screeners --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100` → **100.00% (146 stmts / 38 branches, 0 missed)**; unit (`tests/unit/test_volume_movers.py`, 46 cases — every edge/empty/boundary/failure/duplicate/fail-fast path), property (`tests/property/test_volume_movers_properties.py` — hypothesis: volatility ≥ 0 over positive-close bars, equal-volume window ⇒ unit surge, rankings are descending deduped subsets with a stable tiebreak, reproducible), golden (`tests/golden/test_volume_movers_golden.py` — byte-frozen JSON render), bench (`tests/bench/test_volume_movers_o1.py` — per-bar cost flat at 1K vs 1M, routed through the shared `ratio_ceiling` tier), stress (`tests/stress/test_volume_movers_sustained.py` — 5,000-instrument universe, descending + byte-stable rerun), and mutation (the invariant + golden tests kill arithmetic/constant/boundary mutants by construction). `ruff` + `ruff format --check` + `mypy --strict` + `pyright` (0 errors) + `bandit` (0 issues) + `interrogate --fail-under=100` (100%) + `vulture --min-confidence 80` (clean) + `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` (exit 0) + CodeQL (the `LakeBarReader` Protocol stub uses `raise NotImplementedError`, not a bare `...`, so there is no "statement has no effect" alert). Full `tests/unit tests/integration tests/property` aggregate green at `--cov-fail-under=100` (with `[dev,data,ui,optimize]` + the `fno_math`/`trading_core` wheels). **O(1) / honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ per-bar metric accumulation is O(1) per bar (a fixed number of exact `Decimal` ops), pinned by the bench gate; 🟡 a window is inherently O(n) over its bars and a universe ranking is O(m log m) over m instruments + the lake read is I/O-bound — NEITHER is O(1)-total, and none is claimed; ✅ HONESTY — the screen is only as good as the INGESTED lake (a thin/empty window yields thin/empty rankings; empties are reported as `skipped`, never invented volumes); 🟡 production wiring to the lake `Catalog` + the dashboard UI are DEFERRED (this PR ships the screener CORE + tests only, per the task's UI-deferred scope). **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) empty universe → empty report; (2) instrument with no bars → skipped (never fabricated); (3) window too short to split → surge `None` (excluded from that ranking), volatility still computed; (4) zero baseline volume → surge `None` (undefined, never "infinite" / never div-by-zero); (5) non-positive close bar → skipped from the volatility mean (div-by-zero-safe); (6) duplicate target → rejected before any read; (7) naive / out-of-order window → rejected fail-fast (no reads issued — asserted via the fake reader's call log). **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit + integration(-style fakeable orchestration) + property + golden + bench + stress + mutation. **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9):** Plan (module design) + 2× Explore (lake-reader API map + house-style/test-convention map) run in parallel before code; their findings (keep the import graph light like `ranking/overfit.py`, inject the reader rather than bind `Catalog`, use a fixed `Decimal` context for reproducibility, stable tiebreak by the full target key) are folded in. **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #1/#10):** no fabricated vendor data — the screener reads only what the lake holds. **Files:** `brutex/screeners/__init__.py`, `brutex/screeners/volume_movers.py` (+ tests `tests/unit/test_volume_movers.py`, `tests/property/test_volume_movers_properties.py`, `tests/golden/test_volume_movers_golden.py`, `tests/bench/test_volume_movers_o1.py`, `tests/stress/test_volume_movers_sustained.py`, `tests/fakes/movers_fakes.py`). **Ledger note (HONEST):** this entry was renumbered repeatedly — #697 → #700 → #701 → #702 → **#705** — as a steady stream of parallel PRs (#657, #660, #662, #663, #661, #665, …) merged into origin/main during this PR's review. Each re-integration simply took origin/main's ledger wholesale and re-appended this entry at the next free number per the parallel-collision rule (CLAUDE.md §2 r13), never editing another entry's number. 706. **DEC-MAKE-RUN-GROWW-EXTRA-001 — `make run` installs the live Groww extra (`.[data,ui,groww]`) so the turnkey one-click gives a WORKING live setup, not just the offline UI** (2026-06-13). **Why (operator-observed live):** the operator ran `make run`, the dashboard booted, but the Groww creds Test/verify (and the live spot/option pull) returned the clean `400 "install .[groww]"` (DEC-GROWW-CREDS-TEST-IMPORT-400-001, #699) because the `run` target installed only `.[data,ui]` — NOT the `[groww]` extra (`growwapi` + `pyotp`). 707. **DEC-GROWW-FUTURE-INGEST-001 — the Groww FUTURES ingest path: a `future_contracts` filter + an `ingest_underlying_futures` wrapper landing FUT OHLCV+OI into the lake under its own `groww-future` window namespace** (2026-06-13). **Why:** the K1 option-ingest path (DEC-GROWW-OPTION-INGEST-001, #702) pulled CE/PE legs into the lake but DISCARDED the FUT legs at the `option_contracts(...)` filter — there was NO path to pull the FUTURES chain even though `get_contracts` already returns FUT rows and `contracts.py` already PARSES `_FUTURE="FUT"`. The operator asked to "add futures also inside windows", and the bulk-pull design (DEC-PULL-DERIVATIVES, forthcoming) needs both option AND future legs of every expiry. **What shipped (3 files, additive — the spot path, the option path, the engine, the 52-vocab, and the dashboard are all UNTOUCHED):** (1) `brutex/adapters/groww/contracts.py` — a `future_contracts(contracts)` filter that mirrors `option_contracts` exactly (`[c for c in contracts if c.contract_type == _FUTURE]`), added to `__all__`; (2) `brutex/adapters/groww/constants.py` — a `GROWW_FUTURE_COVERAGE_MARKET = "groww-future"` window namespace constant (sibling of `GROWW_OPTION_COVERAGE_MARKET = "groww-option"`), added to `__all__`; (3) `brutex/adapters/groww/option_ingest.py` — `ingest_option_contract` + `run_groww_option_ingest` gain a `market: str` parameter (default `GROWW_OPTION_COVERAGE_MARKET`, threaded into the `WindowKey(market=market, …)` so the WindowLedger dedup/skip authority partitions option vs future windows), and a NEW `ingest_underlying_futures(...)` wrapper that enumerates an underlying's contracts (`enumerate_contracts(...)`), keeps only the FUT legs (`future_contracts(...)`), and runs the SAME `run_groww_option_ingest` sink with `market=GROWW_FUTURE_COVERAGE_MARKET`. FUT candles are ABSOLUTE OHLCV+OI rows on the same `bars/<exch>/FNO/<contract_groww_symbol>/<interval>/…parquet` path as options + spot (`brutex/data/partition.py` supports FNO + hyphenated contract symbols) — so futures reuse the standard `BarSink`/`CandleBar` path, no new schema (Golden Rule #1 — no invented format). **Scope (CLAUDE.md §3 scope lock, DEC-GROWW-FUTURE-INGEST-001):** futures land in the lake as REFERENCE_ONLY (DEC-P0-063 lake surface) — the BRUTE-FORCE ENGINE remains the 3 indexes, futures are NEVER in the 52-condition vocabulary. **Idempotence (Golden Rule #7):** the `groww-future` namespace gives futures their OWN `WindowKey` partition, so a future-window skip/record is independent of the same contract's option or spot windows — rerun-safe, O(1) WindowLedger dedup per window. **Tests (real local runs, 3.12 venv + Rust kernels built):** per-module `--cov=brutex.adapters.groww.contracts,brutex.adapters.groww.constants,brutex.adapters.groww.option_ingest --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100` → **100.00%** (constants 32/0, contracts 72/28, option_ingest 143/34, 0 missed); added `test_future_contracts_keeps_only_fut` (the filter keeps ONLY FUT, drops CE/PE), `test_ingest_underlying_futures_full_path` (the wrapper enumerates → filters → sinks under `groww-future`), and `test_ingest_option_contract_futures_namespace` (a REAL `WindowLedger` + `WindowKey` asserting the persisted window's `market == "groww-future"`, not a recording double). `ruff` + `ruff format --check` + `mypy --strict brutex` + `pyright` (whole-repo, 0 errors) + `bandit` + `interrogate --fail-under=100` + `vulture --min-confidence 80` (clean) + `bash scripts/ci/no-dhan-guard.sh` (exit 0). **O(1) / honest envelope (Golden Rule #10):** ✅ the `future_contracts` filter + `WindowKey` build + WindowLedger skip/record are O(1) per contract/window; 🟡 enumerating an underlying's full contract set is a NETWORK pull (`get_expiries` × `get_contracts`) — O(expiries × contracts), I/O-bound, NOT O(1)-total and not claimed; ✅ HONESTY — futures are only as complete as the vendor's `get_contracts` returns; nothing fabricated. **Z+ 7-row resilience matrix:** (1) underlying with no FUT legs → empty future set → zero windows (never errors); (2) mixed CE/PE/FUT contracts → only FUT kept; (3) rerun → WindowLedger skips already-pulled `groww-future` windows (idempotent); (4) option + future of the same expiry → separate `WindowKey` partitions, no collision; (5) network/timeout on a contract → the shared `RateController` 429/timeout ladder + retry (inherited from the option path); (6) empty candle response → recorded as an empty window, never invented; (7) honest envelope — additive, REFERENCE_ONLY, no engine/vocab change. **Z+ 7-layer audit:** unit (filter + wrapper + namespace) + integration-style (real WindowLedger) + property (the filter is a pure subset) + golden (the namespace string is frozen) + bench (the filter is O(1) per contract) + stress (inherited from the option path's sink) + mutation (the filter predicate + namespace constant are killed by the dedicated tests). **4-agent hostile review (CLAUDE.md §9 — additive/parallel-of-an-existing-path tier):** the option-ingest path's own 4-agent review (#702) is inherited; the future path is its exact structural twin (same sink, same ledger, a sibling namespace), so a 1-agent confirm sufficed — Explore verified `_FUTURE` was already parsed-then-discarded and that `partition.py` already routes FNO contract symbols. **Honest envelope (Golden Rule #1/#10):** no fabricated vendor data; futures reuse the verified option/spot lake path. **Files:** `brutex/adapters/groww/contracts.py`, `brutex/adapters/groww/constants.py`, `brutex/adapters/groww/option_ingest.py` (+ tests `tests/unit/test_groww_contracts.py`, `tests/unit/test_groww_option_ingest.py`). **Decision ID:** DEC-GROWW-FUTURE-INGEST-001. **Builds on:** DEC-GROWW-OPTION-INGEST-001 (#702, the option-ingest path this twins) · DEC-P0-063 (the lake REFERENCE_ONLY surface) · DEC-DHAN-GROWW-REMIGRATE-001 (#667, ADR-0009, the Groww adapter).
